name: phone-tracker-replica
goal: Prove a paired phone can sync bounded Tracker deltas and query items, notes, flags and runs from SQLite after losing network and restarting.

evidence: Planned phone Tracker replica specification defines scoped pairing, projected delta and snapshot protocol, SQLite, background budgets, local tools, staged writes, and synthetic acceptance criteria.
Implemented versioned hub projection, paired-device read scope, protected SQLite storage, native model read tools, and foreground, BGTask and silent wake entry points.

Tracker pull red reproduced endpoint 404 first. Hub projection, encrypted device boundary, and native Debug (316) and Release (294) headless assertions passed locally. Simulator acceptance remains in verify.
